terra.problem: It assumes the baker picked the answer because the number got stuck in their head.
It says the servant used a shovel, which the passage does not say.
The passage does not say the money stayed buried until it was time to hand it back.
It says the servant states he is afraid and then goes to dig. He tells the master about hiding the money afterward.
It makes a claim about giving to the poor elsewhere in the Bible without a reference.
It says there are only three servants. The passage describes three servants but does not say the master had no others.
It assumes travel is on the baker's mind.
